statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is in the 20-24% band as aligned premarket technology strength meets extreme geopolitical Stress, without verified bar-level mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Current Tail remains below the block threshold; the highest conditional risk is concentrated around 14:25-16:30 Berlin and depends on observed post-release and cash-open price structure.
headline: Premarket technology alignment lifts Tail to WATCH ahead of Empire State and the U.S. open
body: Reuters had Nasdaq-100 E-minis up 0.49% at 10:51 UTC, with Amazon, Alphabet and chipmakers higher while Treasury yields were softer. Fresh Finviz context also showed broad semiconductor strength and lower VIX futures, but it is delayed supporting context only. Strait of Hormuz disruption keeps Stress extreme. Fresh bar-level NQ evidence of failed retracements or persistent extension remains unavailable.

lookbackSummary: Published ChatGPT assessments kept Tail at 17-19% through the prior 24 hours while Stress stayed 88-90%. The Sunday reopening briefly shifted to event/whipsaw, then normalized; early Monday assessments moved to trend-up as technology futures strengthened.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail rises through Empire State, the U.S. cash open and NAHB, peaking at 24% WATCH during opening price discovery. It should decay if meaningful retracements and cross-asset stability appear. Stress rebuilds late in the horizon as Tuesday's housing and import-price cluster approaches.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed premarket technology alignment lifts Tail into WATCH, but fresh bar-level mean-reversion failure is not verified.
Empire State is a scheduled checkpoint; event proximity raises Stress while Tail remains conditional on the post-release path.

Cash-open discovery overlaps NAHB; baseline Tail peaks at 24%, with any block requiring observed persistent one-way structure.
